pairs.target: lú shí sòng wán dìyī bānchuán cái lái , shǒulǐ ná zhe yìzhī hái méi chī de tuánzǐ . tā shuō dàilù de bàn shàngwǔ lìng suàn , tàiyáng dào nàgēn zhuāng dǐng shí dé huíqù , chuánshàng de kè búhuì yīnwèi yǒu yìzhāng xīn tú biàn zìjǐ zhǎodào àn .
pairs.english: Lushi came after the first crossing with an uneaten dumpling. Half a morning's guiding was separate, she said; she must return when the sun reached that post's top. A new map wouldn't let boat passengers find shore by themselves.
pairs.hanzi: 芦实送完第一班船才来，手里拿着一只还没吃的团子。她说带路的半上午另算，太阳到那根桩顶时得回去，船上的客不会因为有一张新图便自己找到岸。

pairs.target: tāmen xiān wǎng nánbiān de suìshí kǒu zǒu . tǎ wéi zuórì xiàguò chuán , jīnrì cóng kèdiàn chūlái , què xiǎnxiē zǒu dào lìng yìtiáo xiǎoxiàng . yuánlái wūhòu guà zhe tóng sè bù , yuǎn kàn xiàng tóngyí dào mén .
pairs.english: They first walked to the southern gravel landing. Though Tavi had landed yesterday, leaving the inn today he nearly took a different alley: matching cloth hung behind houses looked like the same door from afar.
pairs.hanzi: 他们先往南边的碎石口走。塔维昨日下过船，今日从客店出来，却险些走到另一条小巷。原来屋后挂着同色布，远看像同一道门。

pairs.target: lú shí bùkěn tì tā bǎ zhè yícì cuò lù shuō chéng shénme dàshì , zhī shuō nǐ zài biéchù tiāntiān zǒu shú de lù , yě bújiàndé néng rèn zhèbiān yíyè dā qǐlái de jiàzi .
pairs.english: Lushi wouldn't make his wrong turn into anything grand. She only said knowing other roads daily didn't mean recognizing a frame put up here overnight.
pairs.hanzi: 芦实不肯替他把这一次错路说成什么大事，只说你在别处天天走熟的路，也不见得能认这边一夜搭起来的架子。

pairs.target: mù guǎnshì zàiàn lùshang děng tāmen , shǒulǐ shì gè kōng zhúkuāng .
pairs.english: Steward Mou waited on the shore path holding an empty bamboo basket.
pairs.hanzi: 牟管事在岸路上等他们，手里是个空竹筐。

pairs.target: jǐgè zǎo lái shōu cài de rén zhèngzài zhēng guòlù de dìfāng , yíliàngchē héng zài zhǎi kǒu , hòutou yíwèi lǎopópo līn zhe yú , cèshēn yě jǐ bú guòqù .
pairs.english: Early vegetable buyers argued over passage, a cart blocking the narrow entrance and an old woman holding fish unable to squeeze past even sideways.
pairs.hanzi: 几个早来收菜的人正在争过路的地方，一辆车横在窄口，后头一位老婆婆拎着鱼，侧身也挤不过去。

pairs.target: nài lěi ràng zhòngrén xiān gěi tā liú bànbù , zìjǐ zhàn dào chē qián , tóng lāchē de rén jiāng chēwěi tuīxiàng kòngdì .
pairs.english: Nerai asked them to leave her half a step, then went in front of the cart and helped its puller push the tail into open space.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾让众人先给她留半步，自己站到车前，同拉车的人将车尾推向空地。

pairs.target: lù yí ràngkāi , lǎopópo méi jí zhe zǒu , xiān wèn shuí pèng le tā kuāng lǐ de yú . chēfū shuō méi pèng , tā biàn jiāng kuāng gài jiē gěi tā kàn , shuō hái huózhe , pèng sǐ le yě bié xiǎng lài .
pairs.english: Once clear, the old woman didn't hurry away but asked who had touched her fish. The carter denied it; she lifted the lid to show him they lived, warning no denying it if he killed them.
pairs.hanzi: 路一让开，老婆婆没急着走，先问谁碰了她筐里的鱼。车夫说没碰，她便将筐盖揭给他看，说还活着，碰死了也别想赖。

pairs.target: dàjiā xiào qǐlái , mù guǎnshì chènjī bǎ zìjǐ nà zhī kōng kuāng dìjìn diànlǐ , huítóu tóng nài lěi shuō , kèrén ruò dōu cóng zhèlǐ jǐ , xū xiān zhīdào gāi qù nǎlǐ děng .
pairs.english: Everyone laughed. Steward Mou passed his empty basket into the shop and told Nerai that if visitors crowded through here they must first know where to wait.
pairs.hanzi: 大家笑起来，牟管事趁机把自己那只空筐递进店里，回头同奈蕾说，客人若都从这里挤，须先知道该去哪里等。

pairs.target: " suǒyǐ dé xiān huà huòzhàn mén . " tā shuō , " nàlǐ yǒu dìfāng luòjiǎo , búbì bǎ xíngli gē zài biérén zào qián . "
pairs.english: “So the warehouse gate must come first,” he said. “There's room there, no need to leave luggage at someone else's stove.”
pairs.hanzi: “所以得先画货栈门。”他说，“那里有地方落脚，不必把行李搁在别人灶前。”

pairs.target: lú shí jiáo zhe tuánzǐ shuō , yě yǒuxiē kè búzhù tā de diàn , qù nánbiān huàn chuán de , gēnběn búbì dōu dào huòzhàn ménqián .
pairs.english: Chewing her dumpling, Lushi said some guests didn't stay at his inn; those transferring south had no need to detour by the warehouse gate.
pairs.hanzi: 芦实嚼着团子说，也有些客不住他的店，去南边换船的，根本不必兜到货栈门前。

pairs.target: mù guǎnshì shuō zìjǐ méi jiào rén dōu lái zhù , zhǐshì jǐjiā yìzhàn chū le qián , yào yǒu yíchù xiě dé qīngchǔ de jiē lù , bùrán xīn lái de zǒu diū le , yòu guài zhǐ shàng quán shì mén , méiyǒu yíshàn néng jìnqù .
pairs.english: Steward Mou said he wasn't making everyone lodge there; the paying stations needed a clearly marked connection, otherwise newcomers got lost and blamed a paper full of doors none could enter.
pairs.hanzi: 牟管事说自己没叫人都来住，只是几家驿站出了钱，要有一处写得清楚的接路，不然新来的走丢了，又怪纸上全是门，没有一扇能进去。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tīng zhe , cái zhīdào zhè búshì yǒuméiyǒu rén yuànyì tì tāmen zhǐlù de wèntí . liǎnggè rén shuō de dōu néng zǒu , xiǎng jiào chū lái de rén xiān dào de , què búshì tóng yíchù .
pairs.english: Listening, Tavi understood this wasn't about finding someone willing to give directions. Both ways worked, but the first destination they wanted newcomers to reach wasn't the same.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维听着，才知道这不是有没有人愿意替他们指路的问题。两个人说的都能走，想叫初来的人先到的，却不是同一处。

pairs.target: tā dītóu zài zhǐ shàng huà chū gāngcái tuīchē de kòngdì , tiān shàng néng děng rén de wèizhì , méiyǒu xiān huà cūxì bùtóng de liǎnggè jiàntóu .
pairs.english: He drew the space they'd cleared for the cart and marked waiting areas, without first drawing two arrows of unequal weight.
pairs.hanzi: 他低头在纸上画出刚才推车的空地，添上能等人的位置，没有先画粗细不同的两个箭头。

pairs.target: lú shí kàn tā huà dào zìjiā bóchuán kǒu , dǎobǎ tuánzǐ tíng le , shuō zhèbiān néng fàng bāo de táizi yě gāi huà shàng . nài lěi wèn píngrì biérén kěyòng , tā shuō yào xiān wèn tā niáng , táizishàng yǒushí shài yú .
pairs.english: Seeing him reach her family's mooring, Lushi stopped eating: the platform for bags should be drawn too. Nerai asked if others could use it; she said ask her mother first, since fish sometimes dried there.
pairs.hanzi: 芦实看他画到自家泊船口，倒把团子停了，说这边能放包的台子也该画上。奈蕾问平日别人可用，她说要先问她娘，台子上有时晒鱼。

pairs.target: mù guǎnshì tīng le , xiào zhe shuō nà qǐ bù réng dé xiān zhǎo rén . lú shí búzài jiē huà , sānkǒu jiāng shèngxià de tuánzǐ chī le .
pairs.english: Steward Mou laughed: didn't that still mean finding someone first? Lushi stopped answering and finished her dumpling in three bites.
pairs.hanzi: 牟管事听了，笑着说那岂不仍得先找人。芦实不再接话，三口将剩下的团子吃了。

pairs.target: tāmen yánàn zhuǎnguò qù , zhōngyú jiàndào zuórì nà jiān xì hóng shéng de fú wū .
pairs.english: Following the shore, they finally found yesterday's floating house with the red cords.
pairs.hanzi: 他们沿岸转过去，终于见到昨日那间系红绳的浮屋。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi hái méi wèn , yìmíng dūn zài mù biān xǐwǎn de nǚhái biàn shuō nà búshì rèn mén de shéng , shì shài yúwǎng shí shùnshǒu dā zài nàlǐ , jīnrì děng wǎng shōu qǐlái biàn yào názǒu .
pairs.english: Before Tavi asked, a girl washing bowls by the logs said the cords weren't a house marker, just laid there while drying nets and to be removed today when the nets were gathered.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维还没问，一名蹲在木边洗碗的女孩便说那不是认门的绳，是晒鱼网时顺手搭在那里，今日等网收起来便要拿走。

pairs.target: mén lǐ lǎorén tīngjiàn , tàn chūtóu lái wèn tāmen shìbushì mǎi édàn , wèn wán cái rènchū nài lěi .
pairs.english: The old man leaned from the doorway to ask if they wanted goose eggs, only recognizing Nerai after asking.
pairs.hanzi: 门里老人听见，探出头来问他们是不是买鹅蛋，问完才认出奈蕾。

pairs.target: " nǐ qùnián huà dé wǒ mén cháo dōng . " tā shuō , " wǒ zhè wū cháo guò sānhuí dōng , dōngtiān cháo de kěbúshì . "
pairs.english: “Last year you drew my door facing east,” he said. “This house has faced east three times. Not in winter.”
pairs.hanzi: “你去年画得我门朝东。”他说，“我这屋朝过三回东，冬天朝的可不是。”

pairs.target: nài lěi jiāng jiù tú dìgěi tā , méi xiān tì zìjǐ jiěshì . lǎorén méiyǒu jiē , shǒu hái zhān zhe xǐcài shuǐ , zhī jiào nǚhái ná .
pairs.english: Nerai offered the old map without first defending herself. His hands wet from washing vegetables, the old man had the girl take it.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾将旧图递给他，没先替自己解释。老人没有接，手还沾着洗菜水，只叫女孩拿。

pairs.target: nǚhái bǐ tǎ wéi xiǎng de niánzhǎng xiē , zuǐjiǎo yǒu yídào yù hǎo de xì bā , zhǎnkāi zhǐ xiān kàn tú shàng yǒuméiyǒu zìjǐ liàng de wǎn , zhǎo búdào , cái zhǐ gěi tāmen kàn dōngtiān lǎnshéng wǎng nǎ gēn zhuāng shàng huàn .
pairs.english: The girl was older than Tavi expected, with a thin healed scar by her mouth. She unfolded the paper, looked for her drying bowls, and not finding them pointed out which post held the winter mooring rope.
pairs.hanzi: 女孩比塔维想的年长些，嘴角有一道愈好的细疤，展开纸先看图上有没有自己晾的碗，找不到，才指给他们看冬天缆绳往哪根桩上换。

pairs.target: shuǐ dī de shíhòu , fú wū huì gē zài lìng yípiàn shítān . lián dào ànshàng de duǎnbǎn shōuqǐ , rén rào hòutou zǒu , búhuì zǒngzhàn zài tóng yíchù děng huàtú de rén lái rèn .
pairs.english: At low water the house rested on another stony bank. The shore plank was lifted and people went round behind, not forever waiting in one place for mapmakers to identify them.
pairs.hanzi: 水低的时候，浮屋会搁在另一片石滩。连到岸上的短板收起，人绕后头走，不会总站在同一处等画图的人来认。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ dāngrì de rìqī xiě dào wū páng , lìng huà zhuāng yǔ àn lù , xié hé hóng shéng dōu méi huà chéng jìhào .
pairs.english: Tavi dated the house and drew posts and shore paths separately, making neither shoes nor red cords into markers.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把当日的日期写到屋旁，另画桩与岸路，鞋和红绳都没画成记号。

pairs.target: zài wǎngqián , jiù shí àn lùchū bànquān gǒng yǎn , lǐmiàn chuānzhe rújīn shuān kuāng de shéng .
pairs.english: Farther on, half an arched opening showed in the old stone bank, threaded with a rope now used to secure baskets.
pairs.hanzi: 再往前，旧石岸露出半圈拱眼，里面穿着如今拴筐的绳。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎngqǐ biéchù jiù gòujiàn de āocáo , dūnxià kàn le kàn , shí miàn mó dé hěn huá , què méiyǒu néng tóng tā shǒulǐ jiù tú jiēshàng de hào .
pairs.english: Tavi recalled grooves in old components elsewhere and crouched to inspect the worn-smooth stone, finding no numbers linking it to his old drawings.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想起别处旧构件的凹槽，蹲下看了看，石面磨得很滑，却没有能同他手里旧图接上的号。

pairs.target: tā wèn yuánlái zuò shénme , lú shí shuō zìjǐ xiǎoshíhòu biàn rúcǐ , shuǐ tuì shí háizi wǎng lǐ sāi shízǐ ; zhìyú zài zǎo , dé wèn zhīdào de rén , búshì wèn tā zhège jì chuánqián de .
pairs.english: Asked its original purpose, Lushi said it was there in her childhood, children stuffing stones inside at low water. Earlier than that, ask someone who knew, not her counting fares.
pairs.hanzi: 他问原来做什么，芦实说自己小时候便如此，水退时孩子往里塞石子；至于再早，得问知道的人，不是问她这个记船钱的。

pairs.target: nài lěi kàn le yìyǎn , méiyǒu ràng tǎ wéi zhàozhe zìjǐ xiǎngqǐ de dōngxī xiān bǔ shàng yìtái kànbújiàn de jiù jīqì . tā jiāng gǒng yǎn wèizhì jì zài lìng zhǐ shàng , réng huídào jiǎoxià liǎngtiáo shíjì néng zǒu de lù .
pairs.english: Nerai glanced at it without letting Tavi invent an unseen old machine from what he remembered. She noted the opening's location separately and returned to the two usable paths underfoot.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾看了一眼，没有让塔维照着自己想起的东西先补上一台看不见的旧机器。她将拱眼位置记在另纸上，仍回到脚下两条实际能走的路。

pairs.target: huí kèdiàn shí tàiyáng yǐ dào zhuāng dǐng , lú shí lǐng le zhè bàn shàngwǔ de dàilù qián , zhēn jiù wǎng chuánbiān zǒu , méiyǒu wèi péi yuèjiè kè bǎ hòutou de kèrén liúzài ànshàng .
pairs.english: Back at the inn the sun reached the post's top. Lushi collected her guiding pay and really left for her boat, not stranding later passengers to accompany an Outrider.
pairs.hanzi: 回客店时太阳已到桩顶，芦实领了这半上午的带路钱，真就往船边走，没有为陪越界客把后头的客人留在岸上。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wàng zhe tā zǒu yuǎn , jiǎo biān yǒu yìdī cóng túbǎn luòxià de shuǐ , qiàhǎo jiāng tā gāng huà de nà kuài děnghòu kòngdì yīn dà le yìdiǎn . tā bǎ zhǐ tíqǐ , méi náshǒu qù mǒ .
pairs.english: Tavi watched her go. A drop from his drawing board spread the waiting area he'd just drawn slightly wider. He lifted the paper without wiping it with his hand.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维望着她走远，脚边有一滴从图板落下的水，恰好将他刚画的那块等候空地洇大了一点。他把纸提起，没拿手去抹。
